title: The Hex
wikitext:
{{Infobox/Generic |image=The Hex.png }} '''The Hex''' is a feature that allows players to examine their items and to see how they can upgrade them further. It is located in the {{Zone|Hexatorum}} in the [[Hub]]. == Mechanics == '''The Hex''' allows players to insert an item into its menu and examine it. It shows all the upgrades the item currently has and how much further it can be upgraded. It can apply all listed upgrades to the item. To upgrade gear, it can take items from the player's inventory, and [[Storage]]. It can also use the player's {{C}} to buy upgrades from the [[Bazaar]]. '''The Hex''' can be used to remove enchantments, including [[Stacking Enchantments]], [[Endcap Upgrades]], and those applied using [[Enchanted Book]]s rather than the [[Enchantment Table]].
